# Deliberately-violating sample used by tests/architecture/test_no_device_libraries.py
# to prove the import detector actually fires.
#
# Stored with a .txt suffix so pytest never collects it and ruff never lints it.
# This file is NOT part of the application and must never be imported.

import netmiko
import napalm.base
from paramiko import SSHClient


def connect(host, username, password):
    """The exact shape of code R1 exists to keep out of this repository."""
    client = SSHClient()
    client.connect(host, username=username, password=password)
    return netmiko.ConnectHandler(device_type="cisco_ios", host=host)
